g.text: Separate task difficulty from aggregate reward
GRPO-style credit / custom IPO · job 190 · 2 optimizer updates · 32 accepted training traces
Each cell is the mean recorded binary score, with its exact sample count. Gray / — means no scored observations, not zero reward.
Attempts include rejected and unshipped traces; training cells include accepted traces only. Eight-sample task groups are correlated.
Source: recorded training.log + rollout JSON; compact data and input hashes in ../../metrics/rl-metrics.json.
Training-batch diagnostics only. These short runs do not establish convergence or held-out quality.
